text:
Ava Patel: Quick heads-up — found a handful of dead anchors and one stale code snippet in the runtime guide. Planning a micro-patch batch this afternoon (small commits, single PR). Who can review?

Samir Khan: I can look after 3pm PT. Can you paste the file list?

Ava Patel: Files: runtime/kv-cache.md (#kv-cache-ops anchor), api/streaming.md (curl example out-of-date), handbook/images/low-fidelity.png (alt text missing), runbooks/oncall-steps.md (broken internal fragment). Also adding short inline annotations where behavior changed.

Priya Chen: Adding myself as secondary reviewer. Also run the link-checker locally: `yarn docs:link-check` — catches most of these.

docs-bot: PR opened by @Ava: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3888 — 'micro/anchor-annotate-batch' — 6 files changed, 9 commits

Samir Khan: thanks — I'll pull and run `yarn lint:md` + `yarn docs:link-check` on the branch.

Ava Patel: small sed I used for anchors (for anyone doing quick local patch):
```
find . -name '*.md' -exec sed -i '' 's/#kv-cache/#kv-cache-ops/g' {} +
```
(works on mac; use gnu-sed on linux).

Zoe (eng-docs): If it's touching runbooks, forward to runbook owners — tagging @oncall-team in the PR description is usually enough.

Priya Chen: I claimed the image alt text. @Ava can you include a screenshot in the PR so I can verify? :camera_flash: 

Ava Patel: will include screenshot + small caption. @Samir can you set yourself as reviewer in the PR? Would like a quick sanity check on the streaming example.

Samir Khan: set. Also CI shows a minor mkdocs warning about an orphan page — will fix in the same PR.

docs-bot: CI passed (link-check, markdownlint) on PR 3888 — all green.

Ava Patel: merging in 30m unless any objections. planning to tag eng-docs for rollout notes.

Priya Chen: :thumbsup:
